title: 第十七章 侯紫归来
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
夜深得像泼了墨。

    篝火只剩一堆暗红的炭火，明明灭灭。马赖靠在树干上，刀横在腿上，脑袋一点一点，口水顺着嘴角往下淌。刘老四裹着破毯子蜷在角落，鼾声震天，磨牙声在寂静里格外刺耳。

    沈别鹤靠在大石头上假寐，手里死死攥着那枚玉佩，指节发白。呼吸很浅，很不规律，根本没睡着，脑子里全是沈家密藏的影子。

    碎石坡后面，侯紫趴在冰冷的泥土里，手张开接风。

    风告诉他一切，马赖的呼吸粗重，夹杂着烟酒腐蚀过的杂音，每分钟打三次呼噜。刘老四每七分钟翻一次身，翻身时后槽牙磨得最响。沈别鹤的心跳每分钟跳八十次，比常人快了二十次，根本没睡着。

    三个炼气期修士。他手里没有武器，三寸小剑给了沈君壁。

    先杀马赖，再废刘老四，最后对付沈别鹤。

    侯紫深吸一口气，掌心风聚，轻轻推了出去。

    不远处的芦苇荡里，一捆干芦苇被风吹得“哗啦”一声倒在地上。

    马赖猛地惊醒，骂骂咧咧站起来：“谁？”

    没人应声。

    他看了一眼睡死的刘老四，又看了一眼闭目养神的沈别鹤，提着刀走了过去：“刘老四你个懒货，是不是你弄的？”

    走到芦苇堆边，刚想弯腰查看。

    脚下忽然一软。

    表面晒干的泥壳“咔嚓”碎裂，黑臭的淤泥瞬间没过脚踝。

    “不好！”马赖脸色大变，想要往后退。

    侯紫站在上风口，第二把风推了出去。

    旁边几捆一人多高的干芦苇轰然倒塌，把马赖整个埋在底下。他拼命挣扎，越挣扎陷得越深。淤泥很快没过腰，没过胸口。

    他死死抓住插在硬土上的刀柄，想借力把自己拉出去。

    一只手从淤泥里伸出来，抓住了刀柄。然后另一只手也伸了出来，两只手都握住了刀柄，指甲陷进缠在刀柄上的旧布条里。

    他用力一拉。刀没动。

    侯紫站在他面前，脚踩着刀身。

    马赖抬头，从芦苇缝隙里看到了侯紫的眼睛。侯紫只是平静地看着他，和沈别鹤他们在落雁坡劫道时看那些被抢的散修一模一样。

    侯紫弯下腰，捂住马赖的嘴巴。另一只手把马赖的手指一根一根从刀柄上掰开。

    侯紫掰完手指，把手一探，马赖塞在怀里的东西被拿了出来，看都不看，放进了自己怀里，这摸尸手法熟得不得了。

    马赖沉入淤泥，只留下一串气泡。刀还插在硬土上，刀柄微微晃动。

    侯紫转身走向营地。

    刚走到一半，刘老四的鼾声忽然停了。

    他猛地坐起来，拔刀，神识瞬间铺展开来，扫过周围几丈。刚才那声闷响，他听见了。

    神识扫了一圈，什么都没有。马赖不见了，营地空无一人，只有风吹过芦苇的沙沙声。

    刘老四后背出了一层冷汗。他握紧长刀，慢慢站起身，神识一寸一寸扫过每一块石头，每一片草丛。

    他不知道，侯紫就站在他神识范围的边缘，风时的感应更明显了，比他的神识快一步。神识边缘与侯紫风势一碰已被侯紫感知。他往左扫，侯紫就往右躲；他往右扫，侯紫就往左藏。他扫过碎石坡的瞬间，侯紫已经退进了芦苇荡；他扫向芦苇荡的时候，侯紫又绕到了石墩后面。

    像风一样，永远快他一步。

    刘老四越来越慌，手心全是汗。他咬了咬牙，转身想喊沈别鹤。

    头顶“哗啦”一声。

    侯紫站在石墩后面，推下了一堆拳头大的碎石。
content_en:
The night was so deep that it felt like splashing ink.

There was only a pile of dark red charcoal fire left in the bonfire, which was clearly extinguished.Ma Lai leaned against the tree trunk, with the knife across his legs, his head moving slightly, saliva dripping from the corners of his mouth.Liu Laosi was huddled in the corner wrapped in a torn blanket, snoring loudly and grinding his teeth in the silence.

Shen Biehe leaned on the big stone and fell asleep, holding the jade pendant tightly in his hand, his knuckles turned white.His breathing was very shallow and irregular, and he was not asleep at all. His mind was filled with the hidden shadows of the Shen family.

Behind the gravel slope, Hou Zi lay on the cold soil with his hands open to catch the wind.

The wind told him everything. Marai's breathing was heavy, mixed with the noise corroded by tobacco and alcohol, and he was snoring three times a minute.Liu Laosi turns over every seven minutes, and his back molars grind the loudest when he turns over.Shen Biehe's heart beat eighty times per minute, twenty times faster than ordinary people, and he was not asleep at all.

Three monks in the Qi refining stage.He had no weapon in his hand, so he gave the three-inch sword to Shen Junbi.

First kill Ma Lai, then depose Liu Laosi, and finally deal with Shen Biehe.

Hou Zi took a deep breath, gathered wind in his palm, and pushed it out gently.

In the reed marsh not far away, a bundle of dry reeds was blown by the wind and fell to the ground with a "clatter".

Ma Lai woke up suddenly, cursed and stood up: "Who?"

No one answered.

He glanced at Liu Laosi, who was sleeping to death, and then at Shen Biehe, who was concentrating with his eyes closed, and walked over with a knife: "Liu Laosi, you lazy guy, did you do it?"

When I walked to the reed pile, I was about to bend down and check.

His feet suddenly felt weak.

The sun-dried mud shell on the surface cracked and shattered, and the black and smelly mud instantly reached the ankles.

"Not good!" Ma Lai's expression changed drastically and he wanted to step back.

Hou Zi stood upwind and pushed the wind out for the second time.

Several bundles of dry reeds as tall as a person nearby collapsed, completely burying Ma Lai underneath.He struggled desperately, and the harder he struggled, the deeper he sank.The mud soon reached up to my waist and chest.

He firmly grasped the handle of the knife embedded in the hard soil, trying to use the force to pull himself out.

A hand reached out from the mud and grabbed the handle of the knife.Then the other hand stretched out, and both hands grasped the handle of the knife, and their nails dug into the old cloth wrapped around the handle.

He pulled hard.The knife didn't move.

Hou Zi stood in front of him, stepping on the blade of the sword.

Ma Lai looked up and saw Hou Zi's eyes through the cracks in the reeds.Hou Zi just looked at him calmly, just like Shen Biehe and others looked at the rogue cultivators when they were robbed at Luoyanpo.

Hou Zi bent down and covered Ma Lai's mouth.With his other hand, he pried Marai's fingers off the handle of the knife one by one.

After Hou Zi broke off his fingers, he put his hands out and took out the things that Marais had stuffed in his arms. Without even looking at them, he put them into his arms. He was very familiar with this technique of touching corpses.

Marais sank into the mud, leaving only a trail of bubbles.The knife was still stuck in the hard soil, and the handle was shaking slightly.

Hou Zi turned around and walked towards the camp.

Just halfway through, Liu Laosi's snoring suddenly stopped.

He sat up suddenly, drew his sword, and his consciousness instantly spread out, sweeping several feet around him.He heard the muffled sound just now.

His consciousness scanned around and found nothing.Marais was gone, and the camp was deserted except for the rustling of the reeds in the wind.

Liu Laosi broke out in a cold sweat.He held the long knife tightly and stood up slowly. His consciousness scanned every stone and every piece of grass inch by inch.

He didn't know that Hou Zi was standing on the edge of his spiritual consciousness, and Feng Shi's induction was even more obvious, one step faster than his spiritual consciousness.Hou Zi sensed the collision between the edge of his spiritual consciousness and Hou Zifeng's force.When he swiped to the left, Hou Zi hid to the right; when he swiped to the right, Hou Zi hid to the left.The moment he swept across the gravel slope, Hou Zi had already retreated into the reed marsh; when he swept towards the reed marsh, Hou Zi went around behind the stone pier again.

Like the wind, always one step ahead of him.

Liu Laosi became more and more panicked, and his palms were all sweaty.He gritted his teeth and turned around to call Shen Biehe.

There was a "clatter" above the head.

Hou Zi stood behind the stone pier and pushed down a pile of fist-sized gravel.
